crossRefs.note: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
“For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can’t know…
But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But…

translations.web: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.
translations.bsb: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the LORD comprehend fully.
translations.kjv: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand
translations.asv: Evil men understand not justice; But they that seek Jehovah understand all things.
